faqs.question: Which payment methods can you add?
faqs.answer: Cards, Mada, Apple Pay, STC Pay, and BNPL options like Tabby and Tamara — plus global gateways like Stripe/PayPal — based on your market.

faqs.question: Is it secure?
faqs.answer: Yes — we use tokenized, PCI-aware integrations with 3-D Secure so card data is handled safely.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
